ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Set(
    varSelectedHiveNode,
    {
        NodeId: Text(ThisItem.NodeId),
        NodeNo: Text(ThisItem.NodeNo),
        NodeTitle: Text(ThisItem.NodeTitle),
        NodeSubtitle: Text(ThisItem.NodeSubtitle),
        Discipline: Text(ThisItem.Discipline),
        SubsystemCode: Text(ThisItem.SubsystemCode),
        Total: Value(ThisItem.Total),
        Done: Value(ThisItem.Done),
        Remaining: Value(ThisItem.Remaining),
        Progress: Value(ThisItem.Progress),
        ProgressStatus: Text(ThisItem.ProgressStatus),
        ProgressColor: Text(ThisItem.ProgressColor),
        SortOrder: Value(ThisItem.SortOrder)
    }
);

Select(btnHome_LoadPendingSubsystems)

Switch(
    Lower(Trim(cmp_NavApp.SelectedKey)),
    "tasks",   Navigate(scr_Tasks,   ScreenTransition.None),
    "punches", Navigate(scr_Punches, ScreenTransition.None),
    "home",    Navigate(scr_Home,    ScreenTransition.None),
    Notify("Key no mapeada: [" & cmp_NavApp.SelectedKey & "]", NotificationType.Error)
)

With(
    {
        svg:
        "<svg width='72' height='72' viewBox='0 0 72 72' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
            <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#E2E8F0' stroke-width='8'/>
            <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='26' fill='none' stroke='" & ThisItem.ProgressColor & "' stroke-width='8'
                stroke-dasharray='" & Text(ThisItem.Progress * 1.633) & " 163.3'
                stroke-linecap='round'
                transform='rotate(-90 36 36)'/>
            <text x='36' y='35' text-anchor='middle' font-size='14' font-weight='700' fill='#0F172A'>" & ThisItem.Progress & "%</text>
            <text x='36' y='50' text-anchor='middle' font-size='8' fill='#64748B'>Done</text>
        </svg>"
    },
    "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(svg)
)

With(
    {
        _progress: Value(varSelectedHiveNode.Progress),
        _color: Coalesce(varSelectedHiveNode.ProgressColor, "#EF4444")
    },
    "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," &
    EncodeUrl(
        "<svg width='104' height='104' viewBox='0 0 104 104' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
            <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='38' fill='none' stroke='#E2E8F0' stroke-width='12'/>
            <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='38' fill='none' stroke='" & _color & "' stroke-width='12'
                stroke-dasharray='" & Text(_progress * 2.387) & " 238.7'
                stroke-linecap='round'
                transform='rotate(-90 52 52)'/>
            <text x='52' y='52' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' font-size='24' font-weight='700' fill='#0F172A'>" & Text(_progress) & "%</text>
            <text x='52' y='73' text-anchor='middle' font-size='11' fill='#64748B'>Progress</text>
        </svg>"
    )
)

If(
    IsBlank(varProjectId),
    "Select a project",
    varProjectCode & " - " & varProjectName
)
